scopeAudit.packageOwnership: other-animals is the deterministic COL26.8 residual route below Animalia (N); Priapulida B8VF9 has no more-specific static-package route.
scopeAudit.nonApplicableBoundary: All other-animals strict accepted species not descending from B8VF9 are non-applicable to this Priapulida sidecar. They remain in the mixed resource pack and are not silently mapped to ITIS Priapulida.

normalization: Remove the exact trailing COL authorship field from COL scientificName when that suffix is present; no authorship parser is used.
Normalize Unicode to NFC, replace underscores with spaces, collapse Unicode whitespace and trim.
For species-rank comparison, remove one parenthesized subgenus token in the exact Genus (Subgenus) species representation; genus and specific epithet must remain unchanged.
Preserve case, diacritics, punctuation and all remaining name tokens.

statuses.accepted: The normalized COL name resolves to exactly one valid ITIS Priapulida species and directly equals that current ITIS name.
statuses.synonym-current-name-redirect: The normalized COL name equals official ITIS invalid species-name evidence that resolves to exactly one valid ITIS Priapulida species.
statuses.ambiguous: The normalized exact evidence resolves to more than one valid ITIS Priapulida species TSN.
statuses.unmatched: No normalized exact valid-name or official ITIS species-synonym evidence resolves to a valid ITIS Priapulida species.

matchingContract.prohibited: No fuzzy, edit-distance, phonetic, case-folded, diacritic-stripped, token-reordered or taxon-substituted matching is used.

deliveryContract.pagesLight: Pages needs only this small descriptor and may omit all row-level JSONL gzip shards.
deliveryContract.androidIosFull: Android and iOS complete-data inventories must include this descriptor and every listed row-level shard as the same checksum-addressed bytes.
deliveryContract.runtimeChange: This import deliberately changes no formal runtime or published release manifest.

generatedBy.deterministic: Pinned input checksums, fixed roots, exact SQL, exact representation-only normalization, code-unit ID ordering and deterministic gzip; no wall-clock fields or fuzzy matching.
